title: calc-chain: X^5 - 4X + 2 is not solvable by radicals
intent: Refute solvability of X^5 - 4X + 2 by radicals with a three-line rewrite chain: convert radical solvability into solvability of the Galois group, identify that group with Sym_5, and refute solvability of Sym_5, discharging the isomorphism's hypotheses (degree, two non-real roots) by name.

children.name: AbelGaloisPolyRat
children.statement:
Theorem AbelGaloisPolyRat (p : {poly rat}) :
  reflect (solvable_by_radical_poly p) (solvable 'Gal({: numfield p} / 1)).
children.closed_by: rewrite -AbelGaloisPoly (the main Abel-Galois theorem), then the forward direction closes by solvable_ext_polyP and the reverse by the witness numfield p
children.note: Applied as a view (/AbelGaloisPolyRat) to the negated-goal hypothesis, turning solvable_by_radical_poly into solvable 'Gal({:numfield p} / 1). Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: p is solvable by radicals iff the Galois group of its number field is solvable

children.name: isog_gal
children.note: Module lemma of PrimeDegreeTwoNonRealRoots; the parent instantiates it as PDTNRR.isog_gal with the three hypotheses (irreducible, prime degree, two non-real roots). Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: the Galois group of the number field is isomorphic to the symmetric group Sym_d

children.name: size_poly_example
children.note: Supplies the degree: size 6 makes (size p).-1 = 5, so d = 5 and 'I_d becomes 'I_5 in the rewrite. Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: the example polynomial has size (degree+1) six

children.name: solvable_SymF
children.note: Defined in xmathcomp/various.v; with card_ord it turns the goal solvable 'Sym_('I_5) into false. Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: the symmetric group Sym_T is not solvable when it has more than four letters

children.name: count_roots_ex
children.closed_by: suff cR that exactly 3 roots are real; ivt_sign at the three sign changes gives them, and size_root_leSderiv with rootsR_deriv_poly_example bounds them to 3
children.note: Supplies the two non-real roots that the isog_gal hypothesis count_rp' needs; the parent reaches it via count_map. Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: the example polynomial has exactly two non-real roots

applicability.goal_shape: ~ P, where P is a predicate (solvable_by_radical_poly) that a reflect lemma converts into a decidable group-theoretic predicate (solvable of a Galois group), itself refuted by an isomorphism to a known non-solvable group plus a degree/cardinality and a root-count computation.
applicability.use_when: the predicate has an iff/reflect into group solvability; the Galois group is concretely isomorphic to a symmetric or other known group; the degree and root-count facts are already stated as small lemmas; the target group's non-solvability is a library lemma.
applicability.avoid_when: the isomorphism needs a large splitting-field or Galois argument that is not already packaged; the root count needs real analysis (intermediate value theorem) rather than computation; the non-solvability of the target group is not already proved.
